restaurantName: Bếp Mẹ ỉn (Le Thanh Ton Street)
address: 136 Le Thanh Ton Street, Ben Thanh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 700000, Vietnam
bio: Eat like a local at this hidden gem near Ben Thanh Market! Inside, the vivid yellow walls are decorated to echo the exterior of village houses, complete with blue shutters. With its pleasant buzz, the restaurant has a welcoming atmosphere. Perch on one of the wooden stools, as the regulars do, and sample the signature Vietnamese pancake with shrimp and pork, served in a shallow bamboo basket. The fried rice with shrimp and egg, served in a coconut shell, is also worth trying. The service is friendly, portions are perfect for sharing....
pageTitle: Bếp Mẹ ỉn (Le Thanh Ton Street)
